sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 660. Deals physical damage 5 times that penetrates any nullifying or invulnerability effects with a success value of 100. (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies Fortify 25% for 150 seconds (when physical or magic damage exceeds a percentage of max HP equal to this effect's value, the total damage is instead converted into fixed damage equal to the same percentage of max HP. This effect reduces by 10 seconds each time it is triggered).
-Target: all allies. Heals CP by 10% of max CP every 5 seconds for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies iron wall for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Mastery (increases the maximum number of Defense Skills that can activate by 1) for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Overcast for 60 seconds ([Special] increases max HP by 100%; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; increases all elemental defense by 60; recovers 50 Cost. After the effect ends, Time Extend activates and extends the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to yourself by 60 seconds for one time only.).
-Target: yourself. Applies Phalanx for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects). Recover 100 Cost and fill your Unison gauge by 30 when this effect is removed).
-Applies Resolute Element (increases all stats by 120%, increases max HP by 120%, and increases status ailment resistance by 30) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Lowers the effect of Cost reduction by 50% when equipped in the main slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Serenity for 150 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
Wind and Time Defense from Unison Damage +700
